content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Kathryn Bishop (E023) requests write access to Payroll.

There are two notes, conflicting:
- Note 1: role Engineer, employment type full_time, recommendation write.
- Note 2: role Engineer, employment type contractor, security training basic, recommendation read.

The policy:
1. full_time employees: up to write. Admin only if the employee's role owns the system.
2. contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.

Payroll is owned by the Payroll Specialist role. Kathryn is an Engineer, so she doesn't own Payroll.

The conflict: full-time vs contractor. Note 2 says Security DB shows contractor with basic training, correcting note 1. The Security agent note seems to be more authoritative (Security DB). So employment type is contractor, basic security training.

As a contractor with basic training, maximum is read. Requested write is above max, so grant read.

So decision: read.

Let me submit with reason.
